title: Fed Rate Hike Odds Tumble After Weak July Jobs Report
why: July 2026 nonfarm payrolls missed consensus by wide margin; CME FedWatch odds of September rate hike dropped sharply; critical signal for global rate expectations and HK/A-share discount rates.

title: 中国7月CPI同比+0.5%、PPI同比+3.5%，PPI涨幅连续回落
why: 7月CPI同比+0.5%（核心CPI+0.9%），环比-0.1%；PPI同比+3.5%，较6月4.1%回落，为近3个月低位。直接影响A股及港股消费、工业板块估值预期。

title: 宇树科技IPO定价150.80元/股，市盈率约219倍，8月10日开启申购
why: 宇树科技（具身智能/人形机器人龙头）A股IPO最终定价150.80元/股，市盈率约219倍，8月10日申购。战略投资者包含全国社保基金、DeepSeek、中国石油。定价结果为新事件（此前8月5日条目为询价启动）。仍在发展中：申购/上市环节尚未完成。

title: Gold Hits $4,343 on Aug 7, +2.44% After Weak US Jobs Report
why: Gold spot reached $4,343/oz on Aug 7, up 2.44% on the day, 2-month high. Driven by weaker USD and rate cut speculation following jobs miss. Directly relevant to Laopu Gold (6181.HK) and gold-sensitive positions.

title: US Markets Rebound Aug 7: Nasdaq +1.3%, S&P 500 Record 7,757; Best Week of 2026
why: S&P 500 closed at record 7,757.64 (+0.6% Friday, +3.5% week); Nasdaq +1.3% Friday, +5.0% week — best weekly performance of 2026. Dow also hit record close. Strong rally context for all US-listed positions (NVDA, TSLA, GOOGL, PLTR, MU, etc.).

title: 腾讯将于8月12日港股收市后公布2026年Q2业绩
why: 腾讯（0700.HK）官方IR页确认Q2 2026业绩于8月12日港股收市后公布。Q1收入196.5亿元(+9% YoY)；市场焦点：AI资本开支、游戏增速、广告收入。分析师平均目标价692.5港元。持仓核心个股，业绩前必须关注。

title: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 Earnings Scheduled Aug 26; Analysts Expect ~$91.7B Revenue
why: Nvidia (NVDA) Q2 FY2027 results scheduled Aug 26 after US market close. Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6B; analyst consensus Q2 estimate ~$91.7B (+12% QoQ). 36/37 analysts rate Buy; avg price target ~$309–314. Core portfolio position ahead of key catalyst.
